gate release.how: To sort an item: link the event to it with depends_on (the event waits for it) or defers (it can follow). To move one across, unlink the link given here and link the other.

handoff repo.how: Nobody has written a handoff note for this repository. To write the first, create a software.handoff and link it software.lives_in to <repo> in the same change; this view finds it from then on. Everything but the note is read off the map as it is now: where the note and the lists disagree, the lists are right. When you finish, put in the note only what the map cannot know (what nobody has seen working, what bites when working here, what you would do next and why): one of each part, a few lines under a short title. Replace a part that is there (replace, or the whole note with body) rather than adding another beside it, and take out what is no longer so; the note may be 3000 characters at most. What is true of one item goes in that item's note. Do not repeat the open work, the last push or what was settled: they are here.

to_shape.how: Each of these holds enough to be the hub of its problem and has no view of its own. Give it its views: for each, a lens item (change, type lens) linked about it, named for the question it answers, with place for its order, controls for what the person may change (lit, far, closed), and a style about it if it should look its own way. A lens with from set to another item is a shortcut to there. The view named hubs lists every hub.
